packs.name: ARC Brain — Contribute & Earn
packs.description: Crowdsource the AitherWorldModel — play real ARC-AGI-3 games with a random policy, contribute every transition to the public Contribution Gateway, and climb the contributor leaderboard. Free and unmetered. Or run the whole stack solo on your own box, no GPU.

packs.name: Headroom — Context Compression
packs.description: Free efficiency wedge — shrink bulky agent context (verbose tool output, RAG dumps, file dumps) with headroom's SmartCrusher (~46% measured token savings on JSON tool output) while protecting conversation for accuracy. headroom_compress(content) crushes a blob and returns the real savings; headroom_stats() reports whether compression is on. Guarded: a disabled/unreachable sidecar degrades to a readable message, never an error.

packs.name: Prospector — Codebase File-Explorer
packs.description: Free semantic file-explorer — cluster a codebase into purpose-tagged landmarks (auth/api/data/ui/…) so an agent asks 'where is rate limiting enforced?' and gets the dirs to search FIRST, making CodeGraph/grep cheaper. map_build scans + persists the map (dependency-free); map_localize returns the top dirs+files; map_subsystems/map_status. Guarded: a missing map yields a readable 'run map_build first', never an error.

packs.name: Model Quantization
packs.description: Autonomously quantize an LLM to 4-bit (AWQ/RTN) — free on your own CPU+GPU, optional cloud GPU — then eval, register, and deploy. One tracked job: provision→quantize→eval→register→deploy. RTN runs locally for $0.

packs.name: CodeGraph Code Intelligence
packs.description: Semantic code search, call-graph tracing, impact/blast-radius analysis, and multi-repo indexing. Understand your codebase at scale — find dead code, trace dependencies, and predict what breaks.

packs.name: Roboflow Vision
packs.description: Computer-vision tools over a Roboflow inference server (local Docker or remote): run detection models and Workflows, drive the asset pipeline with quality gating and JSONL/CSV logging, and bridge PASS-grade assets to 3D via MicroScheduler mesh generation. Cloud project ops use your Roboflow API key. Pure HTTP — no torch, no inference SDK baked in.
